subject: Can anyone provide a file reading example?

messages.author: abe298c8e45ffaac
messages.subject: Can anyone provide a file reading example?
parts:
I am new to creating a web app. I am trying to build a webpage where
the user can upload a file, and then I can grab the file and process
it. I tried the FILES mentioned in the menu, but not very sure how to
handle the action. Is there any example of file uploading and
processing?

I read the slides, which mentioned not to combine the layout and r
code together. So, ideally, I would like to put the processing code in
a separate file as did in the useR2007.rhtml example.

Any hints or code snippets are highly appreciated. Thank you very
much.

Regards,
LJ

messages.author: 1bf3bb84a245eefc
messages.subject: Re: Can anyone provide a file reading example?
parts:
This is roughtly how I manage to do it with the help of Rapache
manual,
http://rapache.net/manual.html


Here is the steps I followed:

1. Here is the html form, say form.html

<form enctype="multipart/form-data" method="POST"
action="processForm.R">
<input type="file" name="FirstFile">
<input type="file" name="SecondFile">
<input type="submit" name="Upload">


2. Here is the R file to process the files coming from the form.html
(lets call it processForm.R)

setContentType("text/html")
str(FILES)
List of 2
$ FirstFile :List of 2
..$ name : chr "file1.txt"
..$ tmp_name: chr "/tmp/apreqc9GlXE"
$ SecondFile:List of 2
..$ name : chr "file2.txt"
..$ tmp_name: chr "/tmp/apreqoQ2hhX"


destination <- file.path('/usr/local/uploaded_files',FILES$FirstFile
$name)
file.copy(FILES$FirstFile$tmp_name,destination,overwrite=TRUE)

MyData1=read.table("directory-from-above/file1.txt", header=TRUE)
MyData2=read.table("directory-from-above/file2.txt", header=TRUE)

Now do whatever you want with the above MyData1 and MyData2

I hope it helps.

messages.author: 1bf3bb84a245eefc
messages.subject: Re: Can anyone provide a file reading example?
parts:
Hi LJ,

Here is the actual example which works fine on my computer, I have
just tried it, this the processForm.R code

setContentType("text/html")
print(.Internal(getwd()))
cat("<br>")



destination <- file.path('/var/www/images',FILES$FirstFile
$name)


destination2 <- file.path('/var/www/images',FILES$SecondFile
$name)



mydata1<-read.table("/var/www/images/file1.txt",header=TRUE)

mydata1<-read.table("/var/www/images/file2.txt",header=TRUE)

cat("<pre>")
print(mydata1)
cat("</pre>")


Plus you should have this in your httpd.conf file

<Location /R/processForm.R>
SetHandler r-handler
RFileHandler /var/www/R/processForm.R
</Location>

and your /var/www/images directory must be writable by the userID
which apache uses.
Please let me know if you have any further questions.

Regards,

uploaded, processed by R, and the results displayed in the web
browser.  I found the tutorial on installing rapache on Mac OS and
believe I successfully have it up and running on my computer.

I am completely new to creating web apps and am having difficulty
figuring out how to get the useR2007 example app up and running.  Are
there any instructions on where to put what files to get useR2007 up
and running.  Also, are there any generic tutorials on using apache to
build web apps that will get me a bit more acquainted with how the
whole process works.  Thanks in advance for any help.
--Markus
